name: معزآباد جابری

queries.query: Iran official cadastral parcel map GIS Moezabad-e Jaberi Fars Iran cadastral API
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the official national Land Management Single Window at zamin.gov.ir. Its public portal identifies the Iranian Information Technology Organization as operator and links a public land-monitoring application, but no city-specific parcel layer was exposed by indexed discovery.

queries.query: معزآباد جابری کاداستر نقشه قطعات ملکی فارس سامانه رسمی پنجره واحد زمین
queries.result: Persian discovery identified the official سامانه پنجره واحد زمین at zamin.gov.ir and official policy material describing it as the land-services gateway involving the cadastral/registration authority. Search results did not expose a public city parcel dataset or safe parcel ID-plus-geometry response.

registryCustodian.name: Iranian Information Technology Organization / Land Management Single Window (سامانه پنجره واحد زمین)
registryCustodian.scope: National land-service gateway. Official policy material identifies the single window as the land/building service gateway and requires relevant agencies, including the Registration Organization, to provide electronic services; the portal's public API identifies its operator as the Iranian Information Technology Organization.

localCustodianContext.name: No local Fars/Moezabad-e Jaberi cadastral custodian was independently evidenced in the accessible first-party material.
localCustodianContext.scope: National portal context only; local registry office, city coverage, and local parcel service remain unqualified.

service.name: Land Management Single Window public portal and land-monitoring application
service.viewerConfiguration: The current public JavaScript bundle https://zamin.gov.ir/ito/static/js/main.81c594fa.js exposes relative endpoints including /api/forms/getMapForm, /api/forms/getPref, /api/maps/getPolygons, and /api/maps/getGnafPC. The required map name, collection, layer, geometry field, and access state were not available from bounded anonymous configuration requests.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.outcome: Public portal loaded. Its API metadata returned official operator contact information and no parcel geometry.
Anonymous public portal metadata returned; it describes the single-window land service but contains no parcel schema, native ID, CRS, or geometry.
Current public land-monitoring viewer loaded and referenced its JavaScript bundle.

Current bundle inspection identified map/configuration routes, including getMapForm, getPref, getPolygons, and getGnafPC; no source-specific parcel layer or schema was hard-coded in the inspected route strings.
Bounded anonymous requests for services/mapTabs/servicesHelp configuration exceeded 20 seconds without a response. No login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, credential, or private token was attempted.
Official legacy domain redirected toward zamin.gov.ir; direct TLS-followed request also experienced connection reset. No parcel response obtained.
Bounded anonymous request did not return a usable response. No access control was bypassed and no parcel request was made.
